# SoA-Web (Son of Anton)

> SoA-Web is a self-hosted, browser-based terminal: one Node.js process spawns real shell sessions with node-pty and streams them to xterm.js in the browser over WebSocket. It is built for running and supervising AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex) from any browser or a paired phone, with tabs that survive restarts, a fleet manager for many agent sessions, and local-only agent-to-agent coordination tools.

- What it is: an open-source web terminal and AI-agent dashboard, the web version of the Son of Anton desktop app (no Electron)
- Stack: Node.js >= 18, Express, ws, node-pty, xterm.js, plain browser ES modules, Cloudflare Tunnel / ngrok for phone access
- Live site: https://www.s0a.app (Vercel: https://soa-web-ten.vercel.app)
- Install and run: `npm install` then `SOA_WEB_PASSWORD=... npm start`, open http://127.0.0.1:7332
- License: GPL-3.0
